turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen saw his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. I have until 4:40, Hale, so start with who decided that, and when.
I didn't come for the thanks. I'm waiting on an answer: who entered that zero, and did anyone hear Owen out before it went in?
Can I ask you something? How should teachers talk to parents like you? What works?
You want me to teach you how to handle me? Take the zero off Owen's mark, Hale, and then tell me why your own procedure says the parent gets a call before any mark goes in.
What could I have said differently just now?
I'm on the other side of this table, Hale, not in your corner. That's three questions from you and no answers to mine. Either the zero comes off, or I'm in the principal's office before my 4:40 call.
